en.headline: Court of Appeal dismisses government bid to revive Fanling golf course housing plan
en.dek: Judges upheld a 2024 ruling that quashed environmental approval for 12,000 public flats on 9.5 hectares of the resumed site, citing unfair consultation and improper conditions.
body: The Court of Appeal on Monday dismissed the government’s appeal against a High Court decision that quashed environmental approval for a public housing project on part of the Fanling Golf Course.

A three-judge panel led by Chief Judge Jeremy Poon upheld the earlier finding that the Director of Environmental Protection had not followed the law when approving the environmental impact assessment report. The court cited an inadequate public consultation process after supplementary information was added, failure to consider responses from the Hong Kong Golf Club, and conditions that effectively required substantial redesign beyond the scope of conditional approval.

The government had planned to build about 12,000 flats on 9.5 hectares of the 32 hectares resumed in 2023. It said it would study the judgment with its legal team and announce next steps at an appropriate time. The Hong Kong Golf Club welcomed the ruling, describing the Old Course as living heritage.

zh.headline: 上訴庭駁回政府粉嶺高球場公屋計劃上訴
zh.dek: 三名法官維持2024年原審裁決，撤銷環評批准，指公眾諮詢不公及附加條件超出法定權限，涉及約12,000個公屋單位。
body: 高等法院上訴庭周一駁回政府就粉嶺高爾夫球場部分土地興建公屋計劃的上訴，維持原審撤銷環境保護署批准環評報告的決定。
由高等法院首席法官潘兆初帶領的三名法官裁定，環保署署長批核環評報告時未有依法行事。判詞指補充資料加入後未再進行充分公眾諮詢、未考慮球會回應，以及附加條件實際要求大幅重新設計，超出有條件批准的法定範圍。
政府原計劃在2023年收回的32公頃土地中，以9.5公頃興建約12,000個公屋單位。政府發言人表示會與律師團隊詳細研究判詞，適時公布下一步工作。香港哥爾夫球會歡迎裁決，稱舊場是珍貴的活遺產。
